bio: Makorè’s new gourmet venture offers guests a delightful dining experience where the focus is on vegetables, as well as fish from the adjacent fishmongers and local truffles (although the latter are not yet very well known, this alluvial land rich in biodiversity is the perfect habit for different truffle species). The chef and his team have gone back to the roots of the relationship between the Italian culinary traditions of the Este and Gonzaga families and Japanese influences, a relationship which is harmoniously demonstrated in the menu served here.
